description: Update order metadata: customer email, internal notes, PO number, delivery address and custom order fields. Only provided fields change.

customFields.description: Order custom fields by key (keys from the cart config's orderFields). A value sets the field, null removes it; keys not named stay as they are.

notes.description: Internal note, never shown to the buyer

shippingAddress.description: Correct the delivery address; omitted leaves it unchanged
